```{r}
# Clean environment
rm( list = ls() )

# load necessary libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)

library(equaltestMI)

# load data 
# Phenotypes 
phenotypes <- read.delim("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Preliminary Analysis/phenotypes.txt")
## SNPGWAS
SNPGWAS_Fasttree <- read.delim("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Preliminary Analysis/Lea Figures/Data/500_Samples/15.2.Subanalysis_1/16.2.1.Fasttree/SNPGWAS_Fasttree.txt")
```

```{r}
# Function to calculate power given a MAF, effect size, sample size, proportion of cases, number of tests and sgnificance level
power_function <- function(f, b.alt, n_cases, n_controls, n_test, sig = 0.05) {
  # Total sample size
  n <- n_cases + n_controls
  # Proportion of cases
  o <- n_cases / n
  # Effective sample size
  Ne <- n * o * (1 - o)
  # Standard error calculation for the given allele frequency
  SE <- 1 / sqrt(Ne * 2 * f * (1 - f))
  
  # Bonferroni-corrected significance threshold
  sig_mc <- sig / n_test
  q.thresh <- qchisq(sig_mc, df = 1, lower.tail = FALSE)
    # Calculate the power for a given NCP and threshold
  pwr = pchisq(q.thresh, df = 1, ncp=(b.alt/SE)^2, lower=F) # power
  return(pwr)
}

# Calculate power across several MAF and effect sizes
f_seq <- seq(0, 0.5, 0.01)
beta_1.2 <- power_function(f= f_seq,
                        b.alt=log(1.2), 
                        n_cases = sum(phenotypes$X0), 
                        n_controls =(nrow(phenotypes)-sum(phenotypes$X0)), 
                        n_test = nrow(SNPGWAS_Fasttree))

beta_1.5 <- power_function(f= f_seq,
                        b.alt=log(1.5), 
                        n_cases = sum(phenotypes$X0), 
                        n_controls = (nrow(phenotypes)-sum(phenotypes$X0)), 
                        n_test = nrow(SNPGWAS_Fasttree))

beta_1.7 <- power_function(f= f_seq,
                        b.alt=log(1.7), 
                        n_cases = sum(phenotypes$X0), 
                        n_controls = (nrow(phenotypes)-sum(phenotypes$X0)), 
                        n_test = nrow(SNPGWAS_Fasttree))

beta_2 <- power_function(f= f_seq,
                        b.alt=log(2), 
                        n_cases = sum(phenotypes$X0), 
                        n_controls = (nrow(phenotypes)-sum(phenotypes$X0)), 
                        n_test = nrow(SNPGWAS_Fasttree))


beta_5 <- power_function(f= f_seq,
                        b.alt=log(5), 
                        n_cases = sum(phenotypes$X0), 
                        n_controls =(nrow(phenotypes)-sum(phenotypes$X0)), 
                        n_test = nrow(SNPGWAS_Fasttree))

beta_10 <- power_function(f= f_seq,
                        b.alt=log(10), 
                        n_cases = sum(phenotypes$X0), 
                        n_controls =(nrow(phenotypes)-sum(phenotypes$X0)), 
                        n_test = nrow(SNPGWAS_Fasttree))


pwr_df <- rbind(data.frame(f_seq, power= beta_1.2) |> mutate(beta= "1.2"),
                data.frame(f_seq, power= beta_1.5) |> mutate(beta= "1.5"),
                data.frame(f_seq, power= beta_1.7) |> mutate(beta= "1.7"),
                data.frame(f_seq, power= beta_2)|> mutate(beta= "2"),
                data.frame(f_seq, power= beta_5)|> mutate(beta= "5"),
                data.frame(f_seq, power= beta_10)|> mutate(beta= "10"))

# Plot
pwr_df |> 
  ggplot(aes(x=f_seq, y= power, color = beta))+
  geom_point()+
  geom_line()+
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.8, color="red", lty= "dashed")+
  theme_classic()+
  xlab("Minor Allele Frequency (MAF)")+
  ylab("Power")+
  scale_color_manual(name="Effect Size (Odds Ratio)", values = color("light")(6))

```

```{r}
# Assuming SNPGWAS_Fasttree is your dataset with columns "af" (MAF) and "beta" (log-odds ratio)
# Extract MAF and effect size (log-odds ratio)
SNPGWAS_Fasttree |>
  mutate(sig= ifelse(lrt.pvalue < 0.05/nrow(SNPGWAS_Fasttree), "sig", "not sig"))|>
  mutate(MAF= ifelse(af <= 0.5, af, 1-af))|>
  ggplot()+
  geom_point(aes(x=MAF, y= abs(beta), colour = sig))+
  xlab("Minor Allele Frequency (MAF)")+
  ylab("EFFECT SIZE (in log-odds-ratio)")+
  theme_bw()
  
  

# Loop over each set of cases and controls to calculate and plot power curves
Effect_size_function <- function(pw.thresh, N_cases, N_controls, f, b_vals, sig, n_tests){
  pw = rep(NA, length(b_vals)) # Power at each candidate b
  b.for.f = rep(NA, length(f)) # For each f, gives the b value that leads to target power
  p.threshold = sig / n_tests  # Genome-wide significance threshold
  q = qchisq(p.threshold, df = 1, lower = F) # Chi-square value corresponding to significance threshold
  for (i in 1:length(f)){
    pw = pchisq(q, df = 1, ncp = N_cases * N_controls / (N_cases+N_controls) * 2 * f[i] * (1 - f[i]) * b_vals^2, lower = F)
    b.for.f[i] = b_vals[min(which(pw > pw.thresh))] # Find the effect size that achieves the target power
  }
  b.for.f
}


f_seq <- seq(0.01, 0.5, length = 200)

Effect_size_pwr90 <- Effect_size_function(pw.thresh=0.9, 
     N_cases= 20*sum(phenotypes$X0 == 1), 
     N_controls=20*sum(phenotypes$X0 == 0), 
     f= f_seq, 
     b_vals =seq(0, 2, length = 1000),
     sig=0.05, 
     n_tests = nrow(SNPGWAS_Fasttree))

Effect_size_pwr80 <- Effect_size_function(pw.thresh=0.8, 
     N_cases= 20*sum(phenotypes$X0 == 1), 
     N_controls=20*sum(phenotypes$X0 == 0), 
     f= f_seq, 
     b_vals =seq(0, 2, length = 1000),
     sig=0.05, 
     n_tests = nrow(SNPGWAS_Fasttree))

Effect_size_pwr70 <- Effect_size_function(pw.thresh=0.7, 
     N_cases= 20*sum(phenotypes$X0 == 1), 
     N_controls=20*sum(phenotypes$X0 == 0), 
     f= f_seq, 
     b_vals =seq(0, 2, length = 1000),
     sig=0.05, 
     n_tests = nrow(SNPGWAS_Fasttree))

Effect_size_pwr60 <- Effect_size_function(pw.thresh=0.6, 
     N_cases= 20*sum(phenotypes$X0 == 1), 
     N_controls=20*sum(phenotypes$X0 == 0), 
     f= f_seq, 
     b_vals =seq(0, 2, length = 1000),
     sig=0.05, 
     n_tests = nrow(SNPGWAS_Fasttree))

Effect_size_pwr50 <- Effect_size_function(pw.thresh=0.5, 
     N_cases= 20*sum(phenotypes$X0 == 1), 
     N_controls=20*sum(phenotypes$X0 == 0), 
     f= f_seq, 
     b_vals =seq(0, 2, length = 1000),
     sig=0.05, 
     n_tests = nrow(SNPGWAS_Fasttree))

Effect_size_df <- rbind(data.frame(MAF=f_seq, beta= Effect_size_pwr90) |> mutate(power= "90%"),
                data.frame(MAF=f_seq, beta= Effect_size_pwr80) |> mutate(power= "80%"),
                data.frame(MAF=f_seq, beta= Effect_size_pwr70) |> mutate(power= "70%"),
                data.frame(MAF=f_seq, beta= Effect_size_pwr60) |> mutate(power= "60%"),
                data.frame(MAF=f_seq, beta= Effect_size_pwr50) |> mutate(power= "50%"))



# Prepare the data from SNPGWAS_Fasttree
SNPGWAS_Fasttree_v2 <- SNPGWAS_Fasttree |>
  mutate(sig = ifelse(lrt.pvalue < 0.05 / nrow(SNPGWAS_Fasttree), "sig", "not sig")) |>
  mutate(MAF = ifelse(af <= 0.5, af, 1 - af))

# PLOT
ggplot() +
  # Plot points for SNPGWAS_Fasttree
  geom_point(data = SNPGWAS_Fasttree_v2, aes(x = MAF, y = exp(abs(beta)), colour = sig)) +
  # Plot lines for Effect_size_df
  geom_line(data = Effect_size_df, aes(x = MAF, y = exp(beta), colour = power)) +
  # Customize labels and theme
  xlab("Minor Allele Frequency (MAF)") +
  ylab("EFFECT SIZE (in odds-ratio)") +
  theme_bw()
```
